rows.text: Text-to-speech models receive little attention, yet they are currently experiencing similar breakthroughs: Fish Audio's Drama 3 lets you direct an AI voice much like you'd direct a voice actor: start calmly, then let the frustration creep in halfway through the sentence. One can describe the delivery in plain language, right down to which word gets the emphasis. A line as simple as "I didn't say that" can take on a completely different meaning. It supports 83 languages, and the weights are available to download under Fish Audio's Community License, which is super cool :)
